hints.title: Bounded Value Domain
hints.text: Each number is bounded below 128 (less than 2^7), so any bitwise OR combination cannot exceed 127.

hints.title: Prefix and Suffix States
hints.text: Compute left_dp[i][c][v] indicating whether an OR value of v can be achieved by choosing c elements from the prefix nums[0..i-1]. Similarly compute right_dp[i][c][v] for suffixes.

hints.title: Split Point Optimization
hints.text: Iterate over all valid split indices i between k and n - k. For each split, examine pairs (left_or, right_or) of size k and maximize left_or xor right_or.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: k: number of chosen elements in each half
complexity.notes: DP table updates take O(n * k * 128). Cross XOR comparisons take O(n * 128^2) operations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Combinatorial enumeration of subsequences of length 2k is intractable for n up to 400.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: DP table tracks bitset states bounded by 128 values.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes value boundedness (< 128) and applies prefix/suffix DP split techniques.
